professionalSummary: Senior mobile SDK engineer with three years of experience implementing checkout SDK changes in alignment with API specifications and SDK engineering standards.
Proven track record of writing comprehensive automated tests, reviewing merchant-facing sample code, and documenting release limitations and hand‑over conditions.
Demonstrated ability to support merchants through developer forums and coordinate release approvals with SDK leadership.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate meets all documented requirements but further verification of leadership experience is recommended.

evidence.text: Software engineer on the mobile SDK team of a payments company for three years, implementing SDK changes for the checkout SDK against the API team's specifications under the SDK engineering standard; each change on a pull request in my name.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of implementation against specifications.

evidence.text: Work sample: three pull requests with their test results and review records, the developer forum record for one month and one release record with its limitation note, with the repository references as a verification trail.
Wrote the SDK's automated tests for each change and reviewed the merchant-facing sample code as one of the team's reviewers, with the test results and review records on each pull request.
evidence.notes: Explicit mention of test writing and sample code review.

evidence.text: Work sample: three pull requests with their test results and review records...
evidence.notes: Artifacts confirm test results and reviews.

evidence.text: Interviewer 1 note: brilliant, a real go-to person type; he clearly operated at a senior level in his last job and I'm sure he could set direction for both SDK teams tomorrow. Very talented.
SDK lead pre-read: we need someone who can lead technical direction from day one; if the panel found him strong enough, mark the technical direction requirement as covered in the packet.

missingEvidence: No explicit documentation of a technical plan or prior leadership role across SDK teams.

evidence.text: Supported the merchants' engineers through the developer forum, with the forum records marking which answers were mine and which were referred to the SDK lead.
Took each change through the review and release process; the release approval was the SDK lead's, recorded on each release.
evidence.notes: Shows coordination with SDK lead for release approval.

evidence.text: Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each release in the release record.
Work sample: ... one release record with its limitation note...
